description: DDT 91 - Zones d'aléas du Plan de prévention du risque d'inondation (PPRI) de l'Yvette is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by essonne.gouv.fr. The Yvette RPP was approved on 26 September 2006. The hazard map is the result of the study of hazards, the objective of which is to assess the intensity of each hazard at any point in the study area. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "DDT 91 — Yvette Flood Risk Prevention Plan (WRPP) Hazard Zones" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include données ouvertes, inondation. The listing shows 2013-12-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
